full_judgment: 3. Mr Kapil Krishna Goldar is the Tashilder of Vested Property Cell under the Deputy Commissioner's Office, Madaripur who lodged a complaint case in the Court of the Magistrate, 1st Class, Madaripur, being Ckcase No. 509 of 2000 under sections 467/468/471 of the Penal Code, against the accused petitioners namely, Mossamat Farida Begum as accused No. 1 and Mossamat Monwara Begum as accused No. 3 and Abdul. Majid Mia, husband of accused No. 1, who died in the meantime, alleging, inter alia, that the landed property measuring about 11 decimals comprised in RS plot No.4371/4378 under RS khatian No. 679 within mouza Madaripur is vested property and the accused petitioners in connivance with each other created forged deed of purchase in their favour being No. 4511 dated 13-11-2000 with an aim to grab the said property and, as such, committed offence under sections 467/468/471 of the Penal Code.
